model: Dynasonics TFX Ultra transit-time flow / energy meter (BACnet IP Ethernet module)
applies_to: Dynasonics TFX Ultra clamp-on flow and energy transmitters ordered with the Ethernet module, set to BACnet IP.
summary: The TFX Ultra is a clamp-on transit-time ultrasonic flow meter; energy models add two temperature inputs. With the Ethernet module set to BACnet IP it serves 25 analog inputs (signal strength, rate, totalizers, temperatures in °C and °F, flow in fixed units and the unit codes) and one binary output that resets the totalizers.
notes: The table gives a description and object ID only, with no Object_Name column; the description is used as the name here.
AI 2 carries flow rate on flow models and energy rate on energy (BTU) models, in the units chosen in the meter; AI 22-25 report which units.
AI 16-21 give the same flow rate in fixed units (GPM, LPM, CFH, CMH) and velocity (FPS, MPS).
Access is not printed per object; inputs are shown read-only and BO 1 writable as the notes describe.
The BACnet MS/TP version serves a shorter list (AI 1-7, 11, 12, 16, 17 and BO 1).
Source: Table 17 'BACnet IP object mappings', page 75 (26 objects).

source.title: TFX Ultra Flow and Energy Meters User Manual

integration.summary: Order the meter with the Ethernet module, set the IP address and BACnet device ID on its web page, then read the rate, the totalizers and (energy models) the temperatures. Check AI 22-25 once to know the units of AI 2-5.

minimum_points.name: Flow Rate (Flow model) / Energy Rate (BTU model)
minimum_points.why: Flow rate (flow models) or energy rate (BTU models)

minimum_points.name: Signal Strength
minimum_points.why: Signal strength; low means poor coupling

setup: IP address, subnet, gateway and BACnet device ID are set on the Ethernet module's web page, not from the meter keypad.
Web page default address 192.168.0.100, reached with a crossover cable; it asks for a user name and password.
UDP port 0xBAC0 (47808). Device object identifier is settable 1-9999 on the web page.
gotchas: The Ethernet module and the totalizer pulse output option cannot both be fitted on energy models.
BO 1 returns to inactive by itself after the reset.
